tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded session logs a complete demo: navigate to the Magento admin invoices grid, close a popup, fill filters (invoice #, order #, bill-to name, amount range, date range, status), click Search, export results, select a mass action (PDF Invoices) and Submit, open the 'View' page for a chosen invoice, and extract invoice details. Task Definition: Create a deterministic, re-usable automation tool that applies invoice-related filters, runs Search, optionally exports results, triggers mass action, and opens/extracts a single invoice's details. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to the invoices grid URL. 2) Close blocking popup (recorded elementHash). 3) Populate filter inputs (use header-text-relative XPaths to avoid brittle indexes). 4) Set status via select. 5) Click Search and wait for results. 6) Choose export format and click Export (support both select+button and direct links). 7) Choose mass action option and click Submit. 8) Open the View link for the provided invoice number and extract invoice fields. Variable Identification: Required input: admin_invoices_url. Optional inputs: increment_id, order_increment_id, billing_name, status, amount_from, amount_to, invoice_date_from, invoice_date_to, order_date_from, order_date_to, export_format, massaction_option, view_invoice_number. Step Optimization: - Use header text to compute input/select location with XPaths rather than fixed column indexes to improve stability across environments. - Use recorded elementHash for the popup close to ensure deterministic dismissal. - Combine export link/button click into a single step covering both patterns. - Use row-scoped XPath to open 'View' link by invoice number rather than relying on row index. Limitations and Notes: - The tool assumes the admin session is already authenticated. - Datepickers may require JS interactions in some environments; the tool inputs date text values into date inputs (automation should simulate events if needed). - Export and mass-action steps are executed even when corresponding inputs are empty; callers should provide empty values to skip meaningful effect. - If an environment uses different visible labels for options (e.g., localized labels), provide the exact visible text in parameters (status, export_format, massaction_option).
name: magento_admin_invoices_filter_export_view_tool
description: Automate Magento admin invoices grid: navigate to the invoices page, close popup, set filter fields (invoice #, order #, bill-to name, invoice/order date ranges, amount range, status), apply Search, export results, run mass action (PDF Invoices), open a specific invoice View page and extract invoice details. Assumes the agent is already authenticated to the admin panel.

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento admin invoices grid page (assumes already authenticated).
Short wait for page JS to initialize and grid to render.
Close any 'Incoming Message' popup using the recorded dismiss element (if present).
Allow popup close animation to finish and grid to become fully interactive.
Set Invoice # filter (input found under the 'Invoice #' header). Leave empty if {increment_id} is empty.
Set Order # filter (input found under the 'Order #' header). This XPath targets a typical 'from' input if present or the first input in the header cell.
Set Bill to Name filter (input found under the 'Bill to Name' header).
Set Amount 'From' input under the 'Amount' header (if present).
Set Amount 'To' input under the 'Amount' header (if present).
Set Invoice Date 'From' input if available.
Set Invoice Date 'To' input if available.
Set Order Date 'From' input if available.
Set Order Date 'To' input if available.
Select the Status option by its visible text under the 'Status' header (e.g., 'Paid'). If {status} is empty, this step will attempt to select an empty value and typically be a no-op.
Click the Search button to apply filters.
Wait for grid refresh / AJAX to complete after applying filters.
Choose the requested export format from the export dropdown (e.g., 'CSV'). If {export_format} is empty or the control isn't present, this will attempt selection and have no effect.
Click Export button or an export link. This step covers both dropdown+button and direct export link implementations.
steps.xpath: //button[normalize-space(.)='Export'] | //a[contains(translate(., 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'),'csv') and contains(@href,'export')]| //a[contains(translate(., 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'),'excel') and contains(@href,'export')]| //a[contains(translate(., 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'),'xml') and contains(@href,'export')]

steps.description: Wait briefly for download request to start (if any).
Select the mass action option (visible text), e.g. 'PDF Invoices'. If empty or control not present, this will be a no-op.
Click the mass action Submit button to execute the selected mass action.
Wait for mass action to complete (server request / file generation).
Open the 'View' link for the invoice matching {increment_id} (if provided). Uses row-scoped XPath tied to the Invoice # cell for stability.
Wait for the invoice View page to load.
Capture the invoice's identifying fields and relevant action links for verification (e.g., PDF / Print).
steps.goal: Extract invoice detail fields (invoice id, invoice number, order number, bill-to name, totals) and PDF/Print link hrefs from the opened invoice View page.

input_schema.name: admin_invoices_url
input_schema.description: Full URL of the Magento admin invoices grid (example: 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_invoice/'). Agent assumes an active authenticated session.

input_schema.name: increment_id
input_schema.description: Invoice number (Invoice #) to filter by (exact match). Corresponds to the invoice increment id filter in the grid.

input_schema.name: order_increment_id
input_schema.description: Order number (Order #) to filter by (exact match or range if your grid uses from/to inputs).

input_schema.name: billing_name
input_schema.description: Bill to Name filter (partial or full customer name) used in the 'Bill to Name' filter input.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Invoice Status visible label to select (example values: 'Any', 'Pending', 'Paid', 'Canceled'). Use the visible option text exactly as shown in the UI.

input_schema.name: amount_from
input_schema.description: Amount range - From value. Use the same formatting the UI accepts (e.g., '0' or '0.00').

input_schema.name: amount_to
input_schema.description: Amount range - To value. Use the same formatting the UI accepts (e.g., '1000' or '1000.00').

input_schema.name: invoice_date_from
input_schema.description: Invoice Date - From value. Use a format accepted by the site's datepicker (e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY' or the displayed format).

input_schema.name: invoice_date_to
input_schema.description: Invoice Date - To value. Use a format accepted by the site's datepicker.

input_schema.name: order_date_from
input_schema.description: Order Date - From value. Use the format accepted by the datepicker if needed.

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to choose (visible label), e.g. 'CSV', 'Excel', 'XML'. If left empty no export will be attempted.

input_schema.name: massaction_option
input_schema.description: Mass action option visible text to choose (example: 'PDF Invoices'). If empty no mass action selection will be attempted.

input_schema.name: view_invoice_number
input_schema.description: Invoice number (Invoice #) to open the 'View' page for after filtering. If provided the tool will open the View link for this invoice number (exact match).
